Job Title: Senior AI & Full Stack Software Engineer
Company: CloudScale AI
Location: San Jose, CA (Hybrid)
Experience: Minimum 5+ years of software engineering experience

About The Role:
We are looking for a Senior AI & Full Stack Engineer to lead the architecture of enterprise LLM agents and distributed APIs. You will design and build high-scale RAG pipelines, microservices, and reactive user interfaces.

Requirements:
- 5+ years building backend systems and full-stack web applications.
- Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, and Go.
- Production experience with FastMCP, LangChain, or LLM agent frameworks.
- Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis caching, Kafka streaming, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
- Demonstrated system design ownership and technical leadership.
- Knowledge of Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
